Hello LAVAAN members

Measure Development and Psychometrics led by Ronald Landis (Clemson University and Millan Chicago) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar on Measure Development and Psychometrics provides a foundational understanding of constructing and validating research instruments. Researchers utilizing latent variable analysis, often implemented with tools like lavaan, will find the principles of scaling, reliability, and validity directly applicable to refining their measurement models. Mastering these psychometric concepts will enhance the rigor of their latent variable constructs, leading to more robust and interpretable findings in their empirical studies.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
